bio: Nestled within four acres of mature award-winning gardens and spacious terraces, The Bath Priory offers an indulgent Afternoon Tea and sets itself apart as a peaceful haven in a bustling city.  This Georgian house of honey-coloured Bath stone enjoys a tranquil location just a short walk to the city centre. Welcoming guests as if to a private home, The Bath Priory is where much of proprietors Andrew and Christina Brownsword's private art collection adorns the walls.  Afternoon Tea is served in the restaurant, the cosy lounges, The Pantry and or on the terrace.  The menu features a selection of delicate finger sandwiches, delicious homemade cakes, and warm scones served with clotted cream and homemade preserve. A vast selection of teas and coffees are available to have alongside your Afternoon Tea. Or, for a little more indulgence, enjoy a fine glass of Champagne.
